research_title: Posisi dan Keberlanjutan Fiskal Indonesia di antara Ekonomi Asia Terpilih
scientific_caveats: Convergence does not imply fiscal improvement.
Clustering proximity is not a normative ranking.
Cross-period cluster identities are not persistent identities.
FRF results are associational, not causal.
FRF evidence is suggestive but fragile.
The integrated assessment is not a formal Debt Sustainability Analysis.
The research does not provide a binary sustainable/unsustainable verdict.
